mapper.select: SELECT COUNT("dr"."daiya_revision_id") FROM "daiya_revisions" "dr" JOIN "bus_services" "bs" ON "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."daiya_revision_id" = "dr"."daiya_revision_id" AND "bs"."line_route_id" = #{lineRouteId} WHERE "dr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "dr"."service_end_date" > CAST(#{serviceEndDate} AS date) AND "dr"."rosen_id" = #{rosenId}

SELECT "a"."daiya_revision_id" , "a"."daiya_revision_name" , "a"."rosen_id" , "a"."service_end_date" , "a"."service_start_date" , "b"."rosen_name"
ORDER BY "a"."service_start_date" DESC , "b"."rosen_name" ASC LIMIT #{displayNum} OFFSET #{startRowNum}
mapper.update: WITH "target_revisions" AS ( SELECT "dr"."daiya_revision_id" ,"dr"."service_end_date" AS "before_service_end_date" ,CAST(#{serviceEndDate} AS DATE) AS "after_service_end_date" ,"dr"."service_start_date" AS "before_service_start_date" ,CAST(#{serviceStartDate} AS DATE) AS "after_service_start_date" FROM "daiya_revisions" "dr" WHERE "dr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "dr"."rosen_id" = #{rosenId} AND "dr"."service_start_date" < CAST(#{serviceStartDate} AS DATE) AND "dr"."service_end_date" >= CAST(#{serviceStartDate} AS DATE) ), "updated_revisions" AS ( UPDATE "daiya_revisions" SET "service_end_date" = CAST(#{serviceEndDate} AS DATE) - INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE "daiya_revision_id" IN ( SELECT "daiya_revision_id" FROM "target_revisions" ) RETURNING "daiya_revision_id","service_end_date" ), "target_bus_services" AS ( SELECT "bs"."bus_service_id" ,"tr"."before_service_start_date" ,"tr"."after_service_start_date" ,"tr"."before_service_end_date" ,"tr"."after_service_end_date" ,"tr"."daiya_revision_id" FROM "bus_services" "bs" JOIN "target_revisions" "tr" ON "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."daiya_revision_id" = "tr"."daiya_revision_id" ), "deleted_daily_daiyas" AS ( UPDATE "daily_bus_daiyas" "d" SET "del_flag" = "d"."daily_bus_daiya_id" FROM "target_bus_services" "tbs" WHERE "d"."del_flag" = 0 AND "d"."bus_service_id" = "tbs"."bus_service_id" AND "d"."service_date" >= CAST("tbs"."after_service_end_date" AS DATE) AND "d"."service_date" <= CAST("tbs"."before_service_end_date" AS DATE) RETURNING "daily_bus_daiya_id" ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "updated_count" FROM "deleted_daily_daiyas"

WITH "r" AS ( SELECT nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('daiya_revisions', 'daiya_revision_id')) AS "daiya_revision_id" ), "target" AS ( SELECT "dr"."daiya_revision_id" FROM "daiya_revisions" "dr" WHERE "dr"."daiya_revision_id" IN (SELECT "daiya_revision_id" FROM "r") AND "dr"."rosen_id" = #{rosenId} AND "dr"."service_start_date" >= CAST(#{serviceStartDate} AS DATE) ), "upd_daily" AS ( UPDATE "daily_bus_daiyas" "dy" SET "del_flag" = "dy"."daily_bus_daiya_id"
WHERE "dy"."del_flag" = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "bus_services" "bs" WHERE "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."bus_service_id" = "dy"."bus_service_id" AND "bs"."daiya_revision_id" IN (SELECT "daiya_revision_id" FROM "target") ) ), "upd_detail" AS ( UPDATE "bus_daiyas" "bd" SET "del_flag" = "bd"."bus_daiya_id"
WHERE "bd"."del_flag" = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "bus_services" "bs" WHERE "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."bus_service_id" = "bd"."bus_service_id" AND "bs"."daiya_revision_id" IN (SELECT "daiya_revision_id" FROM "target") ) ), "upd_service" AS ( UPDATE "bus_services" "bs" SET "del_flag" = "bs"."bus_service_id"
WHERE "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."daiya_revision_id" IN (SELECT "daiya_revision_id" FROM "target") ) UPDATE "daiya_revisions" "dr" SET "del_flag" = "dr"."daiya_revision_id"
WHERE "dr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "dr"."daiya_revision_id" IN (SELECT "daiya_revision_id" FROM "target")
mapper.select: SELECT "a"."daiya_revision_id" AS "daiyaRevisionId" , "a"."daiya_revision_name" AS "daiyaRevisionName" , "a"."rosen_id" AS "rosenId" , "a"."service_end_date" AS "serviceEndDate" , "a"."service_start_date" AS "serviceStartDate" , "b"."rosen_name" AS "rosenName" FROM "daiya_revisions" "a" INNER JOIN "lines" "b" ON "b"."del_flag" = 0 AND "b"."available_flag" = 1 AND "a"."rosen_id" = "b"."rosen_id" INNER JOIN "agencies" "ag" ON "ag"."del_flag" = 0 AND "ag"."available_flag" = 1 AND "b"."business_corp_id" = "ag"."business_corp_id" WHERE "a"."daiya_revision_id" = #{id} AND "a"."del_flag" = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT("rosen_id") FROM "lines" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "available_flag" = 1 AND "rosen_id" = #{rosenId} AND "service_start_date" <= CAST(#{serviceStartDate} AS DATE) AND "service_end_date" >= CAST(#{serviceStartDate} AS DATE)

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM "daiya_revisions" "d" INNER JOIN "lines" "l" ON "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."rosen_id" = "d"."rosen_id" WHERE "d"."del_flag" = 0 AND "d"."daiya_revision_id" = CAST(#{daiyaRevisionId} AS BIGINT) AND "d"."service_start_date" > CAST(#{baseDate} AS DATE) AND "l"."business_corp_id" = CAST(#{businessCorpId} AS BIGINT)
